name: shrooms_core
description: Talks to a Shrooms daemon over its unix control socket: reads status and the recent log, and changes what the daemon can change on its own — name, node mode, published services, announcing them, meshes on and off, joining a mesh with an invite, leaving one, and restarting to apply the settings that need it. Never who is admitted, which needs an admin key the daemon has never held (ADR-025). Exists because a ui_qml app is sandboxed and may not open a socket; this runs in its own process and can.
